question: Which problems exceed the total number of times they appear in the solution table when counting all occurrences, across steps 1, 2, and 3, where any non-"Stack" model's maximum test score is lower than the "Stack" model's test score for the same step and version?
sql:
-- Full verification: show all problems with their match counts and solution counts
WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score as stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack' AND step IN (1,2,3)
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) as max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack' AND step IN (1,2,3)
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
condition_matches AS (
    SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) as match_count
    FROM stack_scores s
    JOIN non_stack_max n ON s.name = n.name AND s.version = n.version AND s.step = n.step
    WHERE n.max_non_stack_score < s.stack_score
    GROUP BY s.name
),
solution_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM solution GROUP BY name
)
SELECT c.name, c.match_count, s.cnt as solution_count, c.match_count - s.cnt as excess
FROM condition_matches c
JOIN solution_counts s ON c.name = s.name
WHERE c.match_count > s.cnt
ORDER BY c.name

function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- For each problem, version, step: get max non-Stack test score and Stack test score
WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score as stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack' AND step IN (1,2,3)
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) as max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack' AND step IN (1,2,3)
    GROUP BY name, version, step
)
SELECT s.name, s.version, s.step, s.stack_score, n.max_non_stack_score,
       CASE WHEN n.max_non_stack_score < s.stack_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as condition_met
FROM stack_scores s
JOIN non_stack_max n ON s.name = n.name AND s.version = n.version AND s.step = n.step
ORDER BY s.name, s.version, s.step
LIMIT 30", "preview_rows": 30}
